subject: CatalystLabs security intake: SIG scheduling, asset inventory, and pre-call asks
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@catalystlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@catalystlabs.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CatalystLabs security intake and SIG sequencing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — CatalystLabs is excited about Redwood as a potential inference partner. Our security/IT team asked that we kick off the formal intake for SIG and SOC 2 evidence.

Can we schedule a 45-minute intake call next week to walk through: SIG questionnaire scoping, evidence handoff cadence, and a list of initial owners for artifact collection? Attached is our current asset inventory (CL_asset_inventory_v1.xlsx) to give you an idea of what we'll share.

A couple of things they'd like to surface ahead of the call:
- High-level list of where model inference runs (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Log retention and access control summary for request tracing
- Any existing SOC-related artifacts you can pre-share (scope/coverage)

Preferred times: Wed (10/21) or Thu (10/22) mornings PT. If you prefer, send a poll and we'll confirm.

Best,
Elena Costa
Security Lead | CatalystLabs
elena.costa@catalystlabs.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachment: CL_asset_inventory_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 35KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@catalystlabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CatalystLabs security intake and SIG sequencing

Elena — thanks for the asset inventory and the clear ask. We can do a 45-minute intake; Wed 10/21 10:00 AM PT or Thu 10/22 9:30 AM PT both work for our team. I'll hold Wed at 10:00 AM PT tentatively until you confirm.

Pre-call notes from our side:
- I'll run the intake and capture owners/action items (Marissa, Sales Lead)
- Rishi (cc'd) will join from Security to discuss logging, retention, and evidence formats
- Hannah (cc'd) will coordinate artifact uploads and the Drive folder post-call

Two quick asks before the call if possible:
1) Can you mark which rows in the asset inventory are production inference endpoints vs dev/test? That helps us scope SIG items.
2) If you have a CAIQ or baseline SIG you already started, attach it — we'll prefill anything we can to save time.

We'll prepare a short pre-call agenda and a prefilled SIG CSV to accelerate the session.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(650) 555-0124

Attachment: (none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@catalystlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CatalystLabs security intake and SIG sequencing

Adding a couple technical items we'll want to cover on the intake:
- Logging: sample format (JSON lines vs CSV), example events (auth/authz, inference request tracing, errors), and snapshot size. If you can dump a 24h sample (anonymized) that helps us map retention claims to actual artifacts.
- Network topology: which VPCs/subnets your inference traffic originates from and any peering/VPN constraints (if you plan to use Private).
- Data residency: any specific regional restrictions for logs or telemetry.

I'll attach our internal log ingestion SOP that outlines the minimum fields we need to validate request tracing. That'll give your team an exact checklist to produce a usable sample.

Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-sample-log-ingestion-sop.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@catalystlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@catalystlabs.com>, procure@catalystlabs.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CatalystLabs security intake and SIG sequencing

Marissa / Rishi — Wed 10/21 at 10:00 AM PT works for Tom and me; please keep it to 45 minutes. I've updated the asset inventory with a production flag column and attached a quick CAIQ export we started.

A few extra items for the agenda (short):
- Clarify which Redwood artifacts will be sufficient for our procurement team to proceed with a POC (SLA/uptime, model pinning options)
- Confirm evidence upload location and owners (we prefer Drive links with limited access)
- Clarify any data deletion/retention policies for logs post-evidence review

I'll bring Tom (platform lead) for the topology questions and procurement inbox on the thread for any contract-related asks.

Thanks — see you tomorrow.

Elena

Attachment: SIG_questionnaire_prefill.csv (CSV, 12KB); CL_asset_inventory_v1.xlsx (updated)

Great — invite sent for Wed 21 Oct 2026 10:00 AM PT (45 mins). Zoom and agenda are in the invite. For ease of review, I created a shared Drive folder and uploaded: a) a prefilled SIG CSV we generated from your prefill; b) Rishi's log ingestion SOP; c) an evidence checklist template. I'll also add a single-line tracker in the Drive doc that captures action owners; Hannah will follow up after the call with upload instructions and access rights. Looking forward to the session.
